resources.string: DRAFT — Shona neNdebele hazvisati zvaongororwa nevatauri vemitauro iyi. Mamwe mapeji eapp achiri muChirungu. Usavimba neshanduro dzisina kuongororwa pakuita sarudzo dzeutano, mutemo, mari kana mishonga yemuminda.
Sarudzo yemutauro yachengetwa. Mamwe mashoko eapp achiri muChirungu kusvikira aongororwa nevatauri vemutauro.
